title: Align service secrets ContextVM methods between web client and backend handlers
observed_behavior: The services detail route logged `Failed to load service secrets via ContextVM requests: Error: method not found`.
The web store requested `services.secrets.list`, but ContextVM request construction normalized dotted operation names into slash/hyphen methods such as `services/secrets-list`.
The backend service-secrets handlers registered only dotted method names, so slash/hyphen ContextVM requests returned JSON-RPC -32601.
intended_behavior: Service secrets list/create/update/delete/reveal handlers accept the slash/hyphen ContextVM methods emitted by browser requests.
The web service-secrets store handles direct JSON-RPC result payloads and legacy encrypted route payload envelopes without dropping data.
No REST fallback or fake secret behavior is introduced.
